value.rationale: FAIL. The new scientific content is a finite extension from the published cutoff 3000 to the arbitrarily chosen cutoff 3200, obtained by checking 165 residual primes with the existing method. No structural reason singles out 3200, no new analytic bound or infinite family is obtained, and the twenty exceptional indices do not form a natural complete class. Under the stated value bar, this is an unmotivated finite slice rather than a meaningful cutoff theorem.
